verdict.rationale: Database branching is a fair axis for a database product, but the evidence pack shows no branch concept at all. There is nothing about resetting a branch from its parent or restoring a branch to an earlier state. The only related capability is backup-based point-in-time restore, which is a different feature (restoring from backups) and does not count toward branch reset or restore.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reset a branch from its parent or restore it to an earlier state without rebuilding from a dump

citations.quote: A restore from an arbitrary point in time within the revision history of a backup.
